originalSourceText:
Q.8  A robotics engineer models an autonomous vehicle as a single point moving on a 2D
     map to quickly test path-planning algorithms. This model primarily has:

      (A) High fidelity and high resolution

      (B) High fidelity and low resolution

      (C) Low fidelity and low resolution

      (D) Low fidelity and high resolution

       Explanation: (C)

      Refer Slide: 18 of Lecture: 4

      The model ignores many real-world details and represents the vehicle with minimal
        detail.
